FAQ

Frequently asked questions.

Question not listed? Get in touch.

How much does an app cost?

It depends on the scope. After the free initial call you get a fixed price. We often start with a lean first version that you can quickly test with real users.

How does AI consulting actually help me?

I look at your workflows and show where AI saves time, for example with enquiries, appointments or documents. You get an honest assessment, even if the answer is: not worth it here.

How long until my website is live?

A typical business website is usually ready in 2 to 4 weeks. The exact timeline is in your quote.

What if I want to switch later?

Then I hand over code, content, database and access, complete and documented. Your domain and content belong to you from day one.

Can I edit text and images myself?

Yes, if you like. I set the site up so you can edit text and images yourself, and show you how. Or send me a short message and I'll take care of it as part of maintenance.

Where is my data stored?

On servers in Germany. For businesses, I sign a data processing agreement (DPA) under GDPR.

What does the monthly fee include?

Hosting, SSL certificate, daily backups, security updates, your email inboxes and a fixed allowance for small changes. Cancel any month.

Do you only work with clients in Munich?

No. I work remotely with clients wherever they are, in German or English. If you're in Munich, we're welcome to meet in person.
